hook.name: UniHooks Shared Hook
hook.description: A single shared launch hook where each pool creator configures rules at creation time: trading start gate, optional allowlist with expiry, anti-snipe window, buy burn, LP rewards, treasury fee with optional revenue split, sell tax with optional exit-decay clock, same-block guard, volatility fee, and sandwich guard. Rules are immutable after pool creation; exact-output swaps revert when any per-pool fee rule applies. A fixed 0.20% platform fee is charged on every swap in the paired token.
